sources.title: Bangladesh Special Branch: visa on arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The live arrival-visa service is published on the Bangladesh Police Special Branch's specialbranch.gov.bd domain and specifies eligibility, location and duration.
sources.supportingExcerpt: People from the following categories in European countries may obtain a Visa on Arrival (VOA) at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka: ... Tourists.

sources.title: Jordan Tourism Board: visas to Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: Visit Jordan is the official Jordan Tourism Board service and its live nationality table states the Cypriot arrival-visa rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Cyprus | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival, it will cost a total of 40 JOD.

sources.title: Embassy of Panama: immigration and visas
sources.publisher: Embassy of Panama in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official Embassy of Panama consular page publishes Panama's tourist visa rules and its nationality waiver list.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Visa Required ... Cyprus ... The maximum amount of time that you can stay in Panama is three (3) months.

policies.title: Cyprus ordinary passports: Bangladesh arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh Special Branch states that European tourists may obtain a visa on arrival at Dhaka; Cyprus is within that expressly geographic class.
conditions: The named European-tourist route is issued at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka and is a maximum 30-day, single-entry visa.
The officer grants the visa after reviewing supporting documents; fee, funds, return-ticket, passport-validity, work, residence, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Cyprus ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan Tourism Board's live nationality table says a Cyprus passport holder can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: The table identifies Cyprus as applicable and states that the visa is obtained upon arrival for 40 JOD.
Entry point, passport validity, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Cyprus ordinary passports: Panama visa-free visits
policies.summary: Panama's official Embassy lists Cyprus among nationalities requiring no tourist visa.
conditions: The published ordinary nationality waiver permits a tourist stay of up to three months.
Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.
